input.rationale: Sections 9.1 and 9.2 impose a symmetrical cap on both IBM and Bluefly at the greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges paid for the Services, and Section 10 contains a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages that expressly does not apply to Customer's payment obligations — so the cap basis, mutuality and damages exclusion all meet or exceed the fallback. The failure is on carve-outs: only indemnification payments (9.1(a)/9.2(a)) and bodily injury/tangible property sit outside the cap. There is no carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement, and Section 6 (p0080) expressly makes Sections 9 and 10 prevail over the confidentiality agreement for information in the hosting environment, so confidentiality breaches are affirmatively capped. The fallback requires carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, so this is a material shortfall. We therefore add one mutual "Excluded Claims" sentence as new Section 9.3 rather than reopening the cap itself. Noted but not separately flagged here: Section 9.1(2) excludes IBM liability for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data, which is a data-liability issue addressed under the data rules.

proposal.summary: Add mutual uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality/data protection, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) to Section 9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The mutual cap (greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges) works for us, but our position is that breaches of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP sit outside the cap. We have added a single mutual carve-out sentence rather than reopening Sections 9.1 and 9.2; if helpful, we can narrow it to indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement (including Sections 6, 9.1 and 9.2), the limitations of liability in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 do not apply to, and neither party's liability is limited in respect of: (a) a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations; (b) a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8; (c) a party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud; or (d) a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
